title: He Holds All My Times
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A wise man wrote a gentle book
Of seasons, sun and rain:
A time to plant a little seed,
A time to pick the grain.

[Chorus]
So hush, my little wondering one,
Let evening softly fall;
Heavenly Father holds your times,
He holds them, one and all.

[Verse 2]
A time to laugh, a time to cry,
A time to hug you tight,
A time for running in the sun,
A time to rest at night.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
The winter comes, and then the spring,
The morning, then the moon;
And every season has its turn --
Not late, and not too soon.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
So if today was full of smiles,
Or if you had to cry,
He held you through the whole of it,
And He is standing by.

[Chorus]
mood: Turning music. A slow circling pulse under the voice, the way the seasons come round again - the same small figure returning at the top of every verse, never hurrying to arrive anywhere. Fingerpicked guitar tracing that circle, with one low sustained note underneath that stays put while the melody moves through it. Settled rather than wistful, and each verse lands a little lower, so the last line feels like the year itself coming to rest.
